item.title: Chinese vice premier stresses sustained improvement in industrial innovation capacity
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-11
SHANGHAI, Nov. 10 -- Chinese Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing has stressed the need to steadily advance the deep integration of technological and industrial innovation and to continuously enhance industrial innovation capabilities to better support high-quality economic development. Zhang, also a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, made the remarks during an inspection tour in Shanghai, east China, on Monday and Tuesday. During the tour, Zhang visited instrumentation and medical equipment enterprises and learned about their operations. He emphasized the need to better align high-quality sci-tech supply with industrial demand and to use high-end, green and intelligent industrial needs to guide sci-tech innovation, so that innovation outcomes are translated into real productivity faster. He also called for stronger basic research and breakthroughs in advanced basic processes, key basic materials and basic components, better mechanisms for translating research into application and related services, and a sound innovation ecosystem in which enterprises of all sizes and along industrial chains collaborate. Noting that traditional industries remain a foundation for economic growth and employment, Zhang stressed advancing the application of advanced technologies to empower traditional industries and promote their high-quality development. During discussions with grassroots officials and enterprise representatives, Zhang called for creating new consumption scenarios, improving the consumption environment and expanding quality products and services to promote consumption upgrading. He urged better combining investment in physical facilities with institutional and service improvements, stepping up project planning and preparation, and advancing major projects suited to local conditions. Zhang also called for further advancing the development of a unified national market and intensifying efforts to curb "involution-style" competition, so as to foster a fair and orderly market environment.

item.title: Chinese premier to visit Thailand, travel to Philippines for China-ASEAN summit
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-11
BEIJING, Nov. 11 -- At the invitation of Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, Chinese Premier Li Qiang will pay an official visit to Thailand from Nov. 13 to 15, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson announced on Wednesday. At the invitation of President Ferdinand Romualdez Marcos Jr. of the Philippines, the rotating chair of ASEAN, Premier Li will attend the 29th China-ASEAN Summit in Manila from Nov. 15 to 16, the spokesperson added.

item.title: Second China-Canada Strategic Economic and Financial Dialogue concludes in Vancouver
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-10
VANCOUVER, Nov. 9 -- The second China-Canada Strategic Economic and Financial Dialogue was held on Monday in Vancouver. He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, vice premier of the State Council, and Chinese lead person for the dialogue, co-chaired it with Canadian lead persons Francois-Philippe Champagne, minister of finance, and Maninder Sidhu, minister of international trade. He stated that under the strategic guidance of the leaders of both countries, China-Canada relations have turned for the better, and bilateral exchanges have returned to a sound track. He said this dialogue is a concrete measure to implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of both countries, adding that China is willing to work with Canada, upholding the principles of mutual respect, equality, mutual benefit, and seeking common ground while reserving differences, to deepen cooperation in areas such as economy and trade, finance, and investment, promote the stable and healthy development of China-Canada economic relations, and contribute to building a new type of strategic partnership between the two countries. Champagne noted that Canada attaches great importance to its relations with China and is willing to work with the Chinese side to implement the consensus reached by the leaders of both countries, strengthen policy communication and coordination, and deepen mutually beneficial cooperation in the economic and financial fields. Sidhu said that Canada looks forward to further expanding practical cooperation with China in trade and economic sectors and driving greater development in bilateral economic and trade relations. During the dialogue, the two sides reached a series of mutually beneficial outcomes and consensus. He, Champagne, and Sidhu jointly attended a business roundtable with industry leaders from both countries to discuss opportunities to expand bilateral trade and investment on Sunday.

item.title: Book of Xi's discourses on poverty reduction, alleviation published
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-10
BEIJING, Nov. 10 -- A compilation of discourses by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, on poverty reduction and alleviation has been published by the Central Party Literature Press and released nationwide. Compiled by the Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee, the book brings together 55 important articles by Xi on poverty reduction and alleviation. Some of these works are made public for the first time. Since the 18th CPC National Congress in 2012, the CPC Central Committee with Xi at its core has placed poverty alleviation high on its governance agenda and regarded it as the bottom line task in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. China has won a complete victory in the fight against poverty and accomplished the arduous task of eliminating absolute poverty, creating a miracle in the human history of poverty reduction. In the process, the country has blazed a poverty reduction path and formed an anti-poverty theory with Chinese characteristics. Xi's discourses on poverty reduction and alleviation represent an important theoretical achievement in China's poverty alleviation efforts and the latest achievement in adapting Marxist anti-poverty theory to the Chinese context. These discourses provide important guidance for consolidating and expanding the achievements in poverty alleviation and advancing rural revitalization across the board, promoting modernization that delivers common prosperity for all, and building a better world free from poverty and featuring shared prosperity.

item.title: Senior Chinese official stresses high-quality development, security in Yunnan
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-09
KUNMING, Nov. 8 -- Senior Chinese official Wang Xiaohong called for promoting high-quality development based on local conditions while strengthening security measures during an inspection tour of Yunnan Province in southwest China from Saturday to Sunday. Wang, a member of the Secretariat of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and a state councilor, called for fully and faithfully applying the new development philosophy, coordinating development and security, and improving the precision and effectiveness of policy measures to advance high-quality development in light of local conditions. He demanded tough action against prominent illegal activities, including online gambling, telecom fraud, drug-related crimes and smuggling, while stressing the use of technology to strengthen border management and control. Wang visited Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture and the provincial capital Kunming, where he toured border ports, enterprises, industrial parks and public security checkpoints. Wang urged Yunnan to actively participate in high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and focus on its development into a gateway to South and Southeast Asia. He called for measures to improve the capacity and efficiency of passenger and cargo clearance at border ports, advance the high-quality development of pilot free trade zones, strengthen major transport corridors and promote economic growth in border areas. Wang also emphasized the need to capitalize on the province's comparative advantages by developing distinctive industries, including tourism, culture and flower cultivation, and called for stronger innovation-driven development.

item.title: Chinese premier chairs State Council executive meeting
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
BEIJING, Nov. 6 -- A State Council executive meeting presided over by Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Friday called for strengthening confidence and stepping up policy implementation to ensure China fulfils its major economic and social development targets for the year. The meeting urged faster progress on the construction and implementation of major projects and the country's "six networks" of infrastructure, covering water, power, computing, communications, urban underground pipelines and logistics networks. It called for supporting enterprises in expanding investment in equipment upgrades and intangible assets, and strengthening links of consumption between online and offline markets, as well as urban and rural markets, to foster a virtuous cycle between investment and consumption. The meeting called for making full use of various policy funds, ensuring timely and full disbursement of payments to primary-level authorities and enterprises, and better coordinating fiscal and financial policies in boosting domestic demand. It stressed the need to keep employment stable, prevent risks and safeguard people's livelihoods, calling for stronger employment services for key groups and employment assistance for graduates in difficulty. The meeting urged intensified efforts to identify and address workplace safety risks to prevent major accidents, as well as continued efforts to defuse risks related to local government debt and small and medium-sized financial institutions. It called for improving mechanisms to stabilize the capital market, enhancing the stock market's inherent stability and promoting the stable and sound development of the capital market. The meeting stressed the importance of studying economic priorities for next year and strengthening policy coordination across years to sustain positive economic momentum. The meeting also heard a report on social assistance work, and called for further improvement to the social assistance system, noting that social assistance is an important institutional arrangement for ensuring a basic safety net for people's livelihoods. It underlined the significance of expanding the scope of social assistance to meet new needs and strengthening recipients' intrinsic motivation for self-development, while urging efforts to promote service-based social assistance, such as caregiving and other forms of support, to give people in need a greater sense of gain.

item.title: Xi votes in local legislative election in Beijing
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-06
BEIJING, Nov. 6 -- Chinese President Xi Jinping cast his ballot at a polling station in Beijing on Friday to elect deputies to a local people's congress. Xi, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, voted at the Huairentang polling station of the Zhongnanhai electoral district in Xicheng District to elect deputies to the Xicheng district people's congress. Xi stressed efforts to practice whole-process people's democracy, uphold Party leadership, and strengthen oversight throughout the election process to ensure that deputies who meet the people's expectations are elected. Around 3:30 p.m. Friday, Xi arrived at the polling station, gave his voter registration card to staff for verification, and got a ballot. He cast his ballot after filling it. Noting that the election of deputies to people's congresses is an important foundation for upholding, improving and practicing the people's congress system, Xi underlined the need to give full play to democracy, strictly act in accordance with the law, and ensure that the election is carried out fairly and cleanly. On Friday afternoon, other senior Chinese leaders Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi cast their ballots in person, while Han Zheng entrusted a staff member to vote on his behalf. Former Chinese leader Hu Jintao also entrusted a staff member to vote on his behalf. Friday saw people vote at 13,054 polling stations across Beijing to elect 4,898 new deputies to the people's congresses at the district level and 11,137 deputies to the township-level people's congresses.
